app.name: Sohbah Academy
app.description: Student registration, recitation queue, and attendance tracking in one place.

install.title: Install the app
install.subtitle: Put Sohbah on your home screen, and read without a connection.

why.title: Why install it?
why.mushaf: The whole mushaf — all 604 pages — works with no connection at all
why.fast: Opens from the home screen like any app, with no browser around it
why.light: About 3 MB, and no app store needed

installed.title: Already installed 🎉
installed.body: You are running it from your home screen right now. Open the mushaf and turn through the pages you study, and they will be there even in airplane mode.

button.dismissed: Installation cancelled. You can tap the button again any time.

ios.title: On iPhone and iPad
ios.note: Safari never offers this by itself, so it takes two taps by hand — about a minute.
ios.step1: Tap the Share button at the bottom (the square with an arrow ↑)
ios.step2: Scroll down and choose "Add to Home Screen"
ios.safariOnly: You must open the link in Safari — Chrome on iPhone cannot install it.

manual.title: If the button does not appear
manual.body: Open the browser menu (⋮ or ⋯) and choose "Install app" or "Add to Home Screen".
manual.desktop: On a computer: the install icon at the end of the address bar

offline.title: To make the mushaf work offline
offline.body: After installing, open the mushaf once while you are online — it downloads the whole text by itself. After that it works anywhere, including pages you have never opened.

share.title: Send this link to anyone
share.body: The same link works for every student and teacher — it opens this page with the installation steps.

adhkar.subtitle: Morning and evening adhkar — tap a dhikr to count a repetition.
